content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copies of 10th, 12th, graduation and post-graduation mark sheets Copies of mark sheets of professional and other qualifications Experience certificate issued by competent officer Copy of caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC)

content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format published with the notice. Attach self-attested copies of all mark sheets and other documents.
